changes.to: No maker source found (checked 2026-11-17). The maker's site linxrobot.com still covers only its 3D vision products; the wheeled LINXROBOT-L1 was launched on 14 May 2026 through the maker's WeChat account and no official product or spec page exists. Third-party figures (about 170 cm, 150 kg, 24 arm DoF, 3 kg per arm, 8 h) are not used.
Wheeled dual-arm industrial humanoid from LINX Robot (Lingxi), announced in May 2026 for warehouse picking; no maker specification has been published.
